title: HermesRuntimeSpec
description: One per-tenant Hermes runtime (a container on the single Docker host today; a K8s Deployment later). Managed by hm-hermes-manager (a Node module inside hm-control). 1 runtime = 1 tenant. Forward-compatible with multi-host/K8s via container_host.

tenant_id.description: org id — the isolation unit (1 runtime = 1 tenant).

image.description: same hm-hermes image for every tenant — no per-tenant rebuild.

gateway_port.description: host port → container 8642; allocated deterministically (base + hash(tenant) mod range).

networks.description: EXISTING docker networks to attach (MVP: hmtest so hm-control resolves it; optionally s0k0_hivemind). No new per-tenant bridge networks in MVP.

mcp_url.description: HiveMind MCP endpoint wired into the tenant profile (system of record).

api_key_ref.description: env-var name holding the gateway API_SERVER_KEY (e.g. 'env:HERMES_API_SERVER_KEY') — NEVER a literal secret.

mcp_token_ref.description: env-var name for the per-tenant scoped MCP token (6g). Null in MVP (shared key).

org_id.description: HiveMind org id for X-HM-Org-Id scoping; usually == tenant_id.

container_host.description: forward-compat: which host/node runs this runtime. null = the single MVP host. Enables multi-host / K8s migration without an API change.
